# The universe sets the size.

A `.bigbang` is the space. Its `.gravity-spot` reaches the shorter side, so `orbit-12` touches the edge and every other ring is a fraction of it. Resize the parent: the system follows without JavaScript.

center

Parent width

Parent height

Element size `--o-size-ratio`

Fixed reach `--o-force: 500px` (1.x)
Show structure (`.dev-orbit`)

universe
reach
one lane

## .bigbang — the universe

Its box is the space. Square by default: it takes the parent's width, and a parent with a height caps it. Give it any `width`, `height` or `aspect-ratio`.

## .gravity-spot — the center

Where the system starts. Its `--o-force` is the *reach* of gravity: the diameter of `orbit-12`. By default, the shorter side of the universe.

## .orbit-N — a lane

The radius is split into 12 lanes. `orbit-N` runs N lanes from the center; `orbit-13` to `24` lie beyond the edge. Elements on a ring are one lane thick, times `--o-size-ratio`.

## .satellite — a world

Sits on its ring. It is also a universe: a `.gravity-spot` inside it reaches the satellite's edge, so moons scale with planets.

# Progress rings

Three goals on three lanes. The rings fill the box they are given: resize the window and they keep their proportions.

Move
Exercise
Stand

## How it's built

- Lanes 11, 9 and 7 of 12. `orbit-12` would touch the edge.
- `--o-size-ratio: 1.7` on the `.gravity-spot` sets the thickness of every ring at once.
- `shape="rounded"` rounds the ends in proportion to the band.
- The track is `--o-back-fill`, a tint of the ring color.

# Donut chart

Each category is an `<o-arc value>`. Values are shares of 100, and arcs stack in the order they appear in the HTML.

## How it's built

- One ring on lane 9, three lanes thick, with `--o-gap` between segments.
- `interactive` makes each segment hoverable; the rest of the square stays click-through.
- Change a `value` and the following segments move along.

Menu pick one

# Radial menu

Six actions around a hub. Every wedge is the same distance from the pointer, which makes radial menus fast to use.

Hover, click, or use Tab and Enter.

## How it's built

- Six `<o-arc>` without `value` split the ring evenly. `--o-gap` and the thickness are set once, on the ring.
- `interactive` lets the painted wedge receive the pointer; the rest of the square stays click-through.
- Labels are satellites on a second ring of the same lane, turned half a wedge with `--o-from`.
- The hover scale uses `scale`; Orbit positions arcs with `rotate`, so both apply.

# Speedometer

A 270° dial. Ticks, numbers and colored zones live on separate rings that share `range-270 from-225`, so they always line up.

Speed 0 km/h
Floor itBrake

## How it's built

- `fit-range` puts the first and last tick on the ends of the range: 45 minor and 12 major `.vector`s.
- Numbers are satellites on lane 8; zones are three stacked `<o-arc value>` on lane 11.
- The needle is one `.vector` nine lanes long. Its ring turns with `rotate`, which transitions smoothly.
- The readout is a satellite placed at the bottom with `.angle-180`.

# Knob

Drag around the knob, scroll over it, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

## How it's built

- The body is a satellite 15 lanes wide on `orbit-0`. A satellite is a universe too, so the `.gravity-spot` inside it places the indicator dot relative to the knob.
- Turning the knob turns that inner ring with `rotate`.
- Ticks and the progress band share `range-270 from-225`; ticks light up with a class.

# Half gauge

A battery level as 20 cells on a half circle. Below 30% it turns amber, below 15% coral.

Charge
Plug in

## How it's built

- The universe is 2:1 with `.at-bottom`, so the center sits on the bottom edge.
- `--o-force: 100cqw` makes the reach the width instead of the shorter side.
- 20 `<o-arc>` without value split `range-180 from-270`; lit cells get a class.

# Team map

People you work with, by how often you work together. Hover a face to see who it is.

## How it's built

- Three rings of satellites on lanes 5, 8 and 11; Orbit spreads each group evenly.
- Each ring sets its own `--o-size-ratio`, so closer people are bigger.
- `from-N` shifts a ring so faces on different rings don't line up.
- The dashed paths are empty rings with a border.

# Nested systems

The Moon orbits the Earth while the Earth orbits the Sun. The Moon's orbit is defined inside the Earth's satellite, so it scales and travels with it.

Speed 1×

## How it's built

- A `.satellite` is a universe: the `.gravity-spot` inside it reaches the satellite's edge.
- So the Moon on `orbit-10` of the Earth's system stays close to the Earth, whatever the size of the page.
- Each orbit spins with a CSS animation of `rotate` on its ring.

# Compass

The card turns under a fixed mark, like a real compass. Drag it, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

Heading 0°

## How it's built

- The card is a `.gravity-spot` inside the main one. It has the same reach, and `rotate` on it turns every ring together.
- 72 minor and 12 major `.vector`s on lane 11; degrees and cardinal points are satellites on lane 9.
- The rose is eight vectors shaped with `clip-path`.
- The mark and the readout sit outside the card, so they stay still.

# Radar

A beam sweeps the scope every four seconds; each contact flashes as the beam passes it, then fades.

## How it's built

- Range rings are empty rings with a border, every 4 lanes; the crosshair is four `.vector`s twelve lanes long.
- The beam is the `orbit-12` ring itself, painted with a `conic-gradient` and turned by a CSS animation.
- Each contact is a satellite at a fixed bearing (`.angle-N`) on the lane of its distance. Its animation delay comes from that bearing, so it lights up in time with the beam.

# Depth layers

Three gauges stacked in depth. Click a face, or press the button, to bring the next layer forward. Move the pointer over the stage to tilt the stack.

Next layer

## How it's built

- A `.gravity-spot` with `depth` stacks its direct children; `data-depth` moves each one back, and layers keep their apparent size.
- **Composite layers:** each layer is a nested `.gravity-spot` holding a ring, a label and a face. It has the same reach as its parent, so no `--o-force` is needed.
- `outer-perspective` lets an ancestor own the perspective, here so the whole object can tilt. Set `--o-perspective` to the same value.
- Layers do not block the pointer outside their satellites.

---

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/180-degree-gauge.html

# 180° gauge

A rating on a half circle: five named zones, a needle, and the zone you are in lit up.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <!-- A 2:1 universe with its center on the bottom edge. -->
  <div class="bigbang rating at-bottom" role="meter" aria-label="Rating"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot" style="--o-force: 100cqw">
      <!-- Names and zones share range-180 from-270, so each name sits over its zone. -->
      <div class="orbit-11 range-180 from-270 names" id="names" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.4"></div>
      <div class="orbit-9 range-180 from-270 zones" id="zones" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.6; --o-gap: 3"></div>
      <!-- The needle: a vector 8 lanes long, turned with rotate. -->
      <div class="orbit-4 needle-ring" style="--o-size-ratio: 8"><div class="vector needle"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.4">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule hub"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="readout"><strong id="score">0</strong><span id="zone">very poor</span></div>
  <div class="controls">
    <label>Rating <input id="value" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="68"></label>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 14px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .rating { width: min(100%, 520px, 200vh - 340px); aspect-ratio: 2 / 1; }

.zones o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c); opacity: .3; transition: opacity .3s; }
.zones o-arc.on { opacity: 1; }
.names o-arc { --o-fill: transparent; --o-stroke: none; --o-color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.names o-arc.on { --o-color: var(--text); }

.needle-ring { rotate: var(--needle, -90deg); transition: rotate .5s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1); }
.needle { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--text); }
.hub { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--text); }
.readout strong { color: var(--c); }
```

```js
const zones = [
  ['very poor', 'var(--coral)'], ['poor', 'var(--amber)'],
  ['fair', 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber), var(--lime))'],
  ['good', 'var(--lime)'], ['excellent', 'var(--accent)'],
];
// Arcs without value split the range evenly: five zones of 36°.
document.getElementById('zones').innerHTML = zones.map(([, c]) => `<o-arc style="--c: ${c}"></o-arc>`).join('');
document.getElementById('names').innerHTML = zones.map(([name]) => `<o-arc>${name}</o-arc>`).join('');

const gauge = document.querySelector('.rating'), input = document.getElementById('value');
const arcs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.zones o-arc, .names o-arc')];
const set = value => {
  const i = Math.min(4, Math.floor(value / 20)), [name, color] = zones[i];
  gauge.style.setProperty('--needle', `${value * 1.8 - 90}deg`);
  gauge.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', value);
  gauge.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${value}, ${name}`);
  arcs.forEach((arc, j) => arc.classList.toggle('on', j % 5 === i));
  document.querySelector('.readout').style.setProperty('--c', color);
  document.getElementById('score').textContent = value;
  document.getElementById('zone').textContent = name;
};
input.addEventListener('input', () => set(Number(input.value)));
set(Number(input.value));
```

## How it's built

- The [universe](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/bigbang.html) is 2:1 with `.at-bottom`, so the center sits on its bottom edge. `--o-force: 100cqw` makes the reach the width instead of the shorter side.
- Zones and names live on two rings that share `range-180 from-270`. Five [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) without `value` split the half circle evenly, so each name lands in the middle of its zone with no math.
- The names are text arcs with a transparent fill: `--o-color` colors the letters, and `font-size` is the same px size on any ring.
- The needle is one [`.vector`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html) eight lanes long. Its ring turns with `rotate`, from `-90deg` for 0 to `90deg` for 100.
- The universe is a `role="meter"`. The script keeps `aria-valuenow`, and an `aria-valuetext` with the zone name, in step with the drawing.

For "lower is better" metrics like latency, list the zones the other way round, teal first.

## Related

- [240° gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/240-degree-gauge.html): a speedometer with numbers
- [Fuel gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/fuel-gauge.html): a quarter circle for tight spaces
- [Half gauge demo](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/demos/06-semicircle.html): the same universe, in cells
- [Orbit Kit gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/gauge.html): a ready-made component

# 240° gauge

A stepped speedometer: fifteen bands on a 240° arc light up with the speed, each with its number curved over it.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <!-- The dial is open at the bottom, so the universe is cut short there. -->
  <div class="bigbang speedo at-top" role="meter" aria-label="Speed"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="150" aria-valuenow="0">
    <!-- One 240° dial: numbers and bands share range and start. -->
    <div class="gravity-spot" style="--o-range: 240deg; --o-from: 240deg">
      <div class="orbit-11 numbers" id="numbers"></div>
      <div class="orbit-9 bands" id="bands" style="--o-size-ratio: 2.4; --o-gap: 3"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 10">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule readout"><strong id="speed">0</strong><span>km/h</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <label>Speed <input id="value" type="range" min="0" max="150" value="0"></label>
    <button id="drive" aria-pressed="false">Drive</button>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 4px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .speedo { width: min(100%, (100vh - 80px) / .78); aspect-ratio: 1 / .78; }
/* Reach = the width; the center sits half a width from the top. */
.speedo > .gravity-spot { --o-force: 100cqw; margin-top: 50cqw; }

.bands o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: #1d2630; transition: --o-fill .15s; }
.bands o-arc.on { --o-fill: var(--accent); }
.bands o-arc.on:nth-child(n + 10) { --o-fill: var(--amber); }
.bands o-arc.on:nth-child(n + 13) { --o-fill: var(--coral); }
.numbers o-arc { --o-fill: transparent; --o-stroke: none; --o-color: var(--faint); font: 12px var(--mono); }
.numbers o-arc.on { --o-color: var(--text); }
.readout strong { font-size: clamp(28px, 13cqmin, 56px); }
```

```js
// Fifteen steps of 10 km/h. Arcs without value split the 240° evenly.
const steps = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => (i + 1) * 10);
document.getElementById('bands').innerHTML = steps.map(() => '<o-arc></o-arc>').join('');
document.getElementById('numbers').innerHTML = steps.map(n => `<o-arc>${n}</o-arc>`).join('');

const speedo = document.querySelector('.speedo'), input = document.getElementById('value');
const bands = [...document.querySelectorAll('#bands o-arc')], numbers = [...document.querySelectorAll('#numbers o-arc')];
const set = speed => {
  speed = Math.max(0, Math.min(150, Math.round(speed)));
  input.value = speed;
  // A band lights up once the speed is past the middle of its step.
  steps.forEach((top, i) => {
    bands[i].classList.toggle('on', speed >= top - 5);
    numbers[i].classList.toggle('on', speed >= top - 5);
  });
  speedo.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', speed);
  document.getElementById('speed').textContent = speed;
};
input.addEventListener('input', () => set(input.value));

// Drive: the speed wanders toward a new target every couple of seconds.
let timer, target = 0;
document.getElementById('drive').addEventListener('click', event => {
  const on = event.target.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true';
  event.target.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on);
  event.target.textContent = on ? 'Stop' : 'Drive';
  clearInterval(timer);
  timer = setInterval(() => {
    if (on && Math.random() < .03) target = 30 + Math.random() * 115;
    const speed = Number(input.value);
    set(speed + Math.sign((on ? target : 0) - speed) * Math.min(2, Math.abs((on ? target : 0) - speed)));
    if (!on && speed === 0) clearInterval(timer);
  }, 50);
  if (on) target = 90;
});
set(72);
```

## How it's built

- `--o-range: 240deg; --o-from: 240deg` on the [`.gravity-spot`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/gravity-spot.html) opens the dial at the bottom, and every ring inherits it.
- Fifteen [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) without `value` split the range into equal steps. `--o-gap: 3` keeps a dark line between them, so each step reads on its own.
- The numbers are fifteen more arcs on `orbit-11`, with text and a transparent fill. Same count, same range: each number sits over its band.
- Lit bands get a class; `:nth-child(n + 10)` and `(n + 13)` turn the last steps amber and coral.
- The universe is shorter than it is wide, since the dial leaves the bottom free. `--o-force: 100cqw` keeps the reach at the full width, and `.at-top` plus a top margin of half a width puts the center where it would be in a square.
- The readout is a centered satellite ten lanes wide, and the universe is a `role="meter"`.

- [180° gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/180-degree-gauge.html): a half circle with a needle
- [Fuel gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/fuel-gauge.html): a 90° instrument
- [Speedometer demo](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/demos/04-arrow-gauge.html): a 270° dial with ticks and a needle
- [Orbit Kit gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/gauge.html): a ready-made component

# Fuel gauge

A 90° instrument for a corner of a dashboard: E to F, a red reserve and a needle, in a universe cut to the size of the dial.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <!-- Only the top of the circle is used: a 4:3 universe with the center near its bottom. -->
  <div class="bigbang fuel at-bottom" role="meter" aria-label="Fuel"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot" style="--o-range: 90deg; --o-from: 315deg">
      <div class="orbit-12" style="--o-size-ratio: .35"><o-arc class="reserve" value="12.5"></o-arc></div>
      <div class="orbit-11 fit-range minor" id="minor" style="--o-size-ratio: .5"></div>
      <div class="orbit-11 fit-range major" id="major" style="--o-size-ratio: 1"></div>
      <div class="orbit-9 fit-range">
        <div class="satellite"><div class="capsule mark">E</div></div>
        <div class="satellite"><div class="capsule mark">½</div></div>
        <div class="satellite"><div class="capsule mark">F</div></div>
      </div>
      <!-- The side pieces and the needle go back to a full ring, where angle-N and rotate count from the top. -->
      <div class="orbit-6" style="--o-range: 360deg; --o-from: 0deg">
        <div class="satellite angle-270"><div class="capsule pump">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 21V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16M3 21h12M4 10h10M14 8l3 3v6a1.5 1.5 0 0 0 3 0V9l-3-3"/></svg>
        </div></div>
        <div class="satellite angle-90"><div class="capsule readout"><strong id="litres">0 L</strong><span id="range">0 km</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-5 needle-ring" style="--o-size-ratio: 10; --o-range: 360deg; --o-from: 0deg"><div class="vector needle"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.3">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule hub"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <button id="drive" aria-pressed="false">Drive</button>
    <button id="fill">Fill up</button>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 10px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .fuel { width: min(100%, 420px, (100vh - 90px) * 4 / 3); aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }
/* Reach: 138% of the width, so the 90° dial spans the box. The margin lifts the center off the edge. */
.fuel > .gravity-spot { --o-force: 138cqw; margin-bottom: 7cqw; }

.minor .vector { background: var(--faint); }
.major .vector { background: var(--muted); height: 3px; }
.reserve { --o-fill: var(--coral); --o-stroke: none; }
.mark { font-size: clamp(13px, 5cqw, 20px); font-weight: 650; color: var(--muted); }
.pump svg { width: clamp(20px, 8cqw, 34px); fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.low .pump svg { stroke: var(--coral); animation: blink 1s steps(2) infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: .35; } }
.readout strong { font-size: clamp(18px, 7cqw, 30px); }

.needle-ring { rotate: var(--needle, -45deg); transition: rotate .4s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.3, .5, 1); }
.needle { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 8%, var(--coral) 8%); }
.hub { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--coral); }
```

```js
document.getElementById('minor').innerHTML = '<div class="vector"></div>'.repeat(17);
document.getElementById('major').innerHTML = '<div class="vector"></div>'.repeat(5);

const tank = 48, perLitre = 14; // litres, km per litre
const gauge = document.querySelector('.fuel');
let level = 0, timer;
const set = value => {
  level = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
  gauge.style.setProperty('--needle', `${level * .9 - 45}deg`);
  gauge.classList.toggle('low', level < 12.5);
  gauge.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(level));
  const litres = level / 100 * tank;
  document.getElementById('litres').textContent = `${Math.round(litres)} L`;
  document.getElementById('range').textContent = `${Math.round(litres * perLitre)} km`;
};
const run = (step, until) => {
  clearInterval(timer);
  timer = setInterval(() => { set(level + step); if (until(level)) clearInterval(timer); }, 60);
};
const drive = document.getElementById('drive');
drive.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const on = drive.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true';
  drive.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on);
  drive.textContent = on ? 'Park' : 'Drive';
  if (on) run(-.15, l => l <= 0); else clearInterval(timer);
});
document.getElementById('fill').addEventListener('click', () => {
  drive.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
  drive.textContent = 'Drive';
  run(1.5, l => l >= 100);
});
set(30);
```

## How it's built

- `--o-range: 90deg; --o-from: 315deg` on the [`.gravity-spot`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/gravity-spot.html) centers a quarter circle on the top. Every ring inherits it, so ticks, labels and the reserve line up.
- The universe is 4:3 with `.at-bottom`. `--o-force: 138cqw` makes the reach larger than the box, so the 90° of dial that is used fills it, and a bottom margin keeps the hub inside.
- `fit-range` puts the first and last tick, and E and F, on the two ends of the range: 17 minor and 5 major [`.vector`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html)s.
- The reserve is one [`<o-arc value="12.5">`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html): a value counts out of the ring's range, so it covers the first eighth of the 90°.
- The pump, the readout and the needle sit on rings that set the range back to 360° from 0°, so `angle-270` and `angle-90` mean left and right of the hub, and the needle turns from `-45deg` (E) to `45deg` (F).

For a temperature gauge, use C and H and put the red arc on the high end: give it `--o-from: 33.75deg` on its ring.

- [240° gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/240-degree-gauge.html)
- [Car dashboard](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/dashboard.html)
- [Vectors](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html)

# Circular progress with background

The everyday progress ring: one `<o-progress>` draws both the fill and the track behind it.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang upload">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-10" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.6">
        <o-progress value="0" shape="circle" role="progressbar" aria-label="Upload"
                    aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0"></o-progress>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 14">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule readout"><strong id="pct">0%</strong><span id="size">0 of 24 MB</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <button id="upload">Upload</button>
    <label>Value <input id="value" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0"></label>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 12px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .upload { width: min(100%, 100vh - 80px); }

/* The fill and its track: two custom properties on one element. */
.upload o-progress {
  --o-stroke: none;
  --o-fill: var(--violet);
  --o-back-fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet) 14%, transparent);
}
.upload .readout strong { font-size: clamp(28px, 22cqmin, 60px); }
```

```js
const ring = document.querySelector('o-progress'), input = document.getElementById('value');
const set = value => {
  value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
  input.value = value;
  ring.setAttribute('value', value);
  ring.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', Math.round(value));
  document.getElementById('pct').textContent = Math.round(value) + '%';
  document.getElementById('size').textContent = `${(value * .24).toFixed(1)} of 24 MB`;
};
input.addEventListener('input', () => set(Number(input.value)));

// A fake upload: uneven chunks, like a real network.
let timer;
document.getElementById('upload').addEventListener('click', () => {
  clearInterval(timer);
  set(0);
  timer = setInterval(() => {
    set(Number(input.value) + Math.random() * 3);
    if (Number(input.value) >= 100) clearInterval(timer);
  }, 60);
});
set(64);
```

## How it's built

- One [`<o-progress>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/progress.html) on `orbit-10`, 1.6 lanes thick. `value` drives the fill and the element redraws when it changes.
- `--o-fill` colors the fill and `--o-back-fill` the track. A faint tint of the same color says how much is left without competing with it.
- `shape="circle"` rounds both ends in proportion to the band.
- The readout is a satellite on `orbit-0`, fourteen lanes wide, centered with `.at-center`.
- `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow` gives screen readers the same number as the ring.

## Color by value

A status ring changes color with the value. The color is a custom property, so one line of script does it.

```html
<main class="stage row">
  <div class="bigbang status" data-value="18"></div>
  <div class="bigbang status" data-value="56"></div>
  <div class="bigbang status" data-value="92"></div>
</main>
```

```css
.row { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6%; }
.row > .bigbang { width: min(28%, 100vh - 40px); }
.status o-progress { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c); --o-back-fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 14%, transparent); }
.status .readout strong { font-size: clamp(16px, 20cqmin, 34px); color: var(--c); }
```

```js
for (const dial of document.querySelectorAll('.status')) {
  const value = Number(dial.dataset.value);
  const color = value < 30 ? 'var(--coral)' : value < 70 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--accent)';
  dial.style.setProperty('--c', color);
  dial.innerHTML = `
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-10" style="--o-size-ratio: 2">
        <o-progress value="${value}" shape="circle" role="progressbar" aria-label="Status" aria-valuenow="${value}"></o-progress>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 14">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule readout"><strong>${value}%</strong></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}
```

# Dashed circular progress bar

Progress counted in steps, for onboarding, quizzes or streaks: ten arcs split the ring, one per step.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang steps" role="progressbar" aria-label="Onboarding"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="10" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <!-- Arcs without value share the ring equally; --o-gap opens the dashes. -->
      <div class="orbit-10" id="dashes" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.6; --o-gap: 8"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 14">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule readout"><strong id="done">0 of 10</strong><span id="label">steps done</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <button id="back">Back</button>
    <button id="next">Next step</button>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 12px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .steps { width: min(100%, 100vh - 80px); }

.steps o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: #1d2630; }
.steps o-arc.done { --o-fill: var(--blue); }
/* The step in progress breathes. */
.steps o-arc.now { --o-fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 45%, #1d2630); animation: breathe 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes breathe { to { opacity: .45; } }
.steps .readout strong { font-size: clamp(26px, 18cqmin, 52px); }
```

```js
const total = 10;
document.getElementById('dashes').innerHTML = '<o-arc></o-arc>'.repeat(total);
const dashes = [...document.querySelectorAll('#dashes o-arc')], meter = document.querySelector('.steps');
let done = 0;
const set = n => {
  done = Math.max(0, Math.min(total, n));
  dashes.forEach((dash, i) => {
    dash.classList.toggle('done', i < done);
    dash.classList.toggle('now', i === done);
  });
  meter.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', done);
  document.getElementById('done').textContent = `${done} of ${total}`;
  document.getElementById('label').textContent = done === total ? 'all done' : 'steps done';
};
document.getElementById('next').addEventListener('click', () => set(done + 1));
document.getElementById('back').addEventListener('click', () => set(done - 1));
set(6);
```

## How it's built

- Ten [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) without `value` share the ring equally, so ten arcs are ten steps. Twelve arcs would be twelve.
- `--o-gap: 8` on the ring opens the space between dashes, for all of them at once.
- Each step is a class: `.done` fills it, `.now` makes the next one breathe with a CSS animation.
- The universe is a `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuemax="10"`, so the count is read as steps, not percent.

To name each step, add a second ring further out with one satellite per arc. Same count, same ring: each name sits over its dash.

- [240° gauge](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/gauges/240-degree-gauge.html): steps on a partial range
- [Arcs](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html)

# Circular progress with handle

A circular slider: a progress ring and a handle on the same lane, so the handle always sits where the fill ends.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang dimmer" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Brightness"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-10" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.2">
        <o-progress value="0" shape="circle"></o-progress>
      </div>
      <!-- Same lane, its own ring: turning the ring moves the handle. -->
      <div class="orbit-10 handle-ring" style="--o-size-ratio: 2">
        <div class="satellite"><div class="capsule handle"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 14">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule readout"><strong id="level">0%</strong><span>brightness</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <p class="controls">Drag the handle or use the arrow keys.</p>
</main>
```

```css
.stage { gap: 8px; align-content: center; }
.stage > .dimmer { width: min(100%, 100vh - 70px); touch-action: none; cursor: grab; }
.controls { margin: 0; }

.dimmer o-progress { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--amber); --o-back-fill: #1d2630; }
.handle-ring { rotate: var(--turn, 0deg); }
.handle {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--amber), 0 4px 14px #000;
}
.dimmer:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.dimmer:focus-visible .handle { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--amber), 0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 35%, transparent); }
.dimmer .readout strong { font-size: clamp(28px, 22cqmin, 60px); }
```

```js
const slider = document.querySelector('.dimmer'), ring = slider.querySelector('o-progress');
let value = 0;
const set = v => {
  value = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(v)));
  ring.setAttribute('value', value);
  // Progress and angle-N both start at the top and grow clockwise: 1% is 3.6°.
  slider.style.setProperty('--turn', value * 3.6 + 'deg');
  slider.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', value);
  document.getElementById('level').textContent = value + '%';
};
const fromPointer = event => {
  const box = slider.getBoundingClientRect();
  const angle = Math.atan2(event.clientX - (box.left + box.width / 2), (box.top + box.height / 2) - event.clientY) * 180 / Math.PI;
  const next = ((angle + 360) % 360) / 3.6;
  // Don't jump from 100 to 0 across the top.
  if (Math.abs(next - value) < 50) set(next);
};
slider.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { slider.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); fromPointer(event); });
slider.addEventListener('pointermove', event => { if (slider.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) fromPointer(event); });
slider.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  const step = { ArrowUp: 1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowDown: -1, ArrowLeft: -1, PageUp: 10, PageDown: -10 }[event.key];
  if (step) { event.preventDefault(); set(value + step); }
  if (event.key === 'Home') set(0);
  if (event.key === 'End') set(100);
});
set(60);
```

## How it's built

- The [`<o-progress>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/progress.html) and the handle are on two rings of the same lane, `orbit-10`, so they line up at any size.
- The band is 1.2 lanes thick and the handle 2 lanes wide, set with `--o-size-ratio` on each ring, so the handle stands out past the edges.
- A [satellite](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/satellite.html) alone on a ring sits at the top. Turning its ring with `rotate` moves it smoothly to any angle: `value × 3.6deg`, the same angle where the fill ends.
- The universe is the `role="slider"`: focusable, with arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End, and pointer capture for dragging.

- [Progress with background](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/progress/circular-progress-with-background.html)
- [Knob with progress bar](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/knobs/knob-with-progress-bar.html): the same value as a knob
- [Build a knob](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/guide.html): drag and keyboard, step by step

# Stacked circular progress bars

Three metrics around one center, each ring labeled in the open quarter where it starts.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang server" role="group" aria-label="web-01 usage">
    <!-- Every ring uses three quarters of the circle, from the top. -->
    <div class="gravity-spot" style="--o-range: 270deg; --o-size-ratio: 1.6">
      <div class="orbit-11"><o-progress class="cpu" shape="rounded" role="progressbar" aria-label="CPU"></o-progress></div>
      <div class="orbit-9"><o-progress class="memory" shape="rounded" role="progressbar" aria-label="Memory"></o-progress></div>
      <div class="orbit-7"><o-progress class="disk" shape="rounded" role="progressbar" aria-label="Disk"></o-progress></div>
      <!-- Labels: curved text on the same lanes, ending just before the top. -->
      <div class="orbit-11 label" style="--o-from: 356deg"><o-arc class="cpu" range="auto" text-anchor="end">CPU</o-arc></div>
      <div class="orbit-9 label" style="--o-from: 356deg"><o-arc class="memory" range="auto" text-anchor="end">Memory</o-arc></div>
      <div class="orbit-7 label" style="--o-from: 356deg"><o-arc class="disk" range="auto" text-anchor="end">Disk</o-arc></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 8">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule readout"><strong>web-01</strong><span>live</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage > .server { width: min(100%, 100vh - 56px); }
.cpu { --c: var(--accent); }
.memory { --c: var(--violet); }
.disk { --c: var(--amber); }
.server o-progress { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c); --o-back-fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 14%, transparent); }
.label o-arc { --o-fill: transparent; --o-stroke: none; --o-color: var(--c); font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; }
.server .readout strong { font-size: clamp(18px, 14cqmin, 30px); }
```

```js
// Each metric drifts a little every second, like a live feed.
const metrics = [['cpu', 42], ['memory', 68], ['disk', 81]];
const tick = () => {
  for (const metric of metrics) {
    const [name, value] = metric;
    const drift = name === 'disk' ? .2 : 9;
    metric[1] = Math.round(Math.max(3, Math.min(97, value + (Math.random() - .5) * drift)));
    const ring = document.querySelector('o-progress.' + name);
    ring.setAttribute('value', metric[1]);
    ring.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', metric[1]);
    const label = document.querySelector('o-arc.' + name);
    label.textContent = `${label.textContent.split(' ')[0]} ${metric[1]}%`;
  }
};
tick();
setInterval(tick, 1200);
```

## How it's built

- Three [`<o-progress>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/progress.html) on lanes 11, 9 and 7 of one [`.gravity-spot`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/gravity-spot.html): concentric with no positioning.
- `--o-range: 270deg` and `--o-size-ratio: 1.6` are set once on the system. Every ring picks them up, and 1.6 lanes on rings two lanes apart leaves a thin gap.
- Each label is an [`<o-arc range="auto">`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) on the same lane as its ring: the arc is as long as its text. `text-anchor="end"` ends it at `--o-from: 356deg`, just before the ring starts.
- Changing `value` or the text is all the script does; Orbit redraws the arcs.

- [Progress with background](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/progress/circular-progress-with-background.html)
- [Layered status rings](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/layered-status-rings.html): rings stacked in depth instead
- [Progress rings demo](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/demos/01-minimal-gauge.html): three full rings with a total
- [Orbit Kit rings](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/rings.html)

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/knobs/knob-with-progress-bar.html

# Knob with progress bar

A gain knob whose arc grows from the center position, to the left for cuts and to the right for boosts.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang knob" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Gain"
       aria-valuemin="-12" aria-valuemax="12" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-11 range-270 from-225 fit-range ticks" id="ticks" style="--o-size-ratio: .7"></div>
      <div class="orbit-10 range-270 from-225 track" style="--o-size-ratio: .8"><o-arc></o-arc></div>
      <!-- The arc fills its ring; the script moves the ring's start and range. -->
      <div class="orbit-10 gain" style="--o-size-ratio: .8"><o-arc shape="rounded"></o-arc></div>
      <!-- The body is a satellite 15 lanes wide, with a system of its own for the pointer. -->
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 15">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule body"></div>
          <div class="gravity-spot turn">
            <div class="orbit-8" style="--o-size-ratio: 3"><div class="vector pointer"></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-11">
        <div class="satellite angle-180"><div class="capsule readout"><strong id="db">0 dB</strong><span>gain</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage > .knob { width: min(100%, 100vh - 40px); touch-action: none; cursor: grab; }
.knob:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.ticks .vector { background: var(--faint); }
.ticks .vector:is(:first-child, :nth-child(13), :last-child) { background: var(--muted); height: 2px; }
.track o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: #1d2630; }
.gain o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c, var(--accent)); }
.knob.cut { --c: var(--coral); }

/* Brushed metal: a conic gradient on a round capsule. */
.body {
  width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle, transparent 58%, #0a0d11 60%, #0a0d11 61%, transparent 63%),
    conic-gradient(#3a4552, #222a33, #4a5664, #20272f, #3a4552, #222a33, #4a5664, #20272f, #3a4552);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -12px #000, inset 0 1px 0 #55606e;
}
.turn { rotate: var(--turn, 0deg); transition: rotate .08s linear; }
.pointer { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--text); }
.knob:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.knob:focus-visible .body { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent), 0 18px 40px -12px #000; }
.knob .readout strong { font-size: clamp(20px, 7cqmin, 30px); }
```

```js
document.getElementById('ticks').innerHTML = '<div class="vector"></div>'.repeat(25);
const knob = document.querySelector('.knob'), gain = knob.querySelector('.gain');
let value = 0;
const set = v => {
  value = Math.max(-12, Math.min(12, Math.round(v * 2) / 2));
  const angle = value / 12 * 135; // ±135° from the top
  // The arc's ring starts at the top for a boost, and at the value for a cut.
  gain.style.setProperty('--o-from', `${value < 0 ? 360 + angle : 0}deg`);
  gain.style.setProperty('--o-range', `${Math.abs(angle)}deg`);
  knob.classList.toggle('cut', value < 0);
  knob.style.setProperty('--turn', angle + 'deg');
  knob.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', value);
  document.getElementById('db').textContent = `${value > 0 ? '+' : value < 0 ? '−' : ''}${Math.abs(value)} dB`;
};
// Pointer angle around the center, -135° to 135°.
const fromPointer = event => {
  const box = knob.getBoundingClientRect();
  const angle = Math.atan2(event.clientX - (box.left + box.width / 2), (box.top + box.height / 2) - event.clientY) * 180 / Math.PI;
  if (Math.abs(angle) <= 135) set(angle / 135 * 12);
};
knob.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { knob.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); fromPointer(event); });
knob.addEventListener('pointermove', event => { if (knob.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) fromPointer(event); });
knob.addEventListener('dblclick', () => set(0));
knob.addEventListener('wheel', event => { event.preventDefault(); set(value - Math.sign(event.deltaY) * .5); }, { passive: false });
knob.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  const step = { ArrowUp: .5, ArrowRight: .5, ArrowDown: -.5, ArrowLeft: -.5, PageUp: 3, PageDown: -3 }[event.key];
  if (step) { event.preventDefault(); set(value + step); }
  if (event.key === 'Home') set(-12);
  if (event.key === 'End') set(12);
});
set(4.5);
```

Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys. Double-click to reset to 0 dB.

## How it's built

- The ticks and the dark track share `range-270 from-225`, the usual knob sweep with the gap at the bottom. `fit-range` puts the first and last of the 25 [`.vector`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html)s on the two ends.
- The colored arc is one [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) without `value`, so it fills its ring's range. The script sets that ring's `--o-from` and `--o-range`: from the top for a boost, from the value back to the top for a cut.
- The body is a [satellite](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/satellite.html) fifteen lanes wide on `orbit-0`. A satellite is a universe too, so the `.gravity-spot` inside it places the pointer relative to the knob, and `rotate` on that system turns it.
- The universe is the `role="slider"`, with pointer capture for dragging and the usual keys.

- [LED knob](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/knobs/led-knob.html): discrete steps
- [Circular progress with handle](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/progress/circular-progress-with-handle.html)
- [Knob demo](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/demos/05-knob.html): a 0 to 100 volume knob
- [Build a knob](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/guide.html): a step-by-step guide
- [Orbit Kit knob](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/knob.html)

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/knobs/led-knob.html

# LED knob

A knob with discrete steps: eleven LEDs, one per position, lit up to the current one, and a pointer that snaps between them.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang knob" tabindex="0" role="slider" aria-label="Drive"
       aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="10" aria-valuenow="0">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <!-- One LED per step: satellites on the knob's 290° sweep. -->
      <div class="orbit-11 range-290 from-215 fit-range leds" id="leds" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.3"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 16">
        <div class="satellite at-center">
          <div class="capsule skirt"></div>
          <div class="gravity-spot">
            <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 17"><div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule cap"></div></div></div>
            <!-- The pointer turns with the system that holds it. -->
            <div class="orbit-9 turn" style="--o-size-ratio: 4"><div class="vector pointer"></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-11">
        <div class="satellite angle-180"><div class="capsule readout"><strong id="step">0</strong><span>drive</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage > .knob { width: min(100%, 100vh - 40px); touch-action: none; cursor: grab; }
.knob:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.leds .capsule { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #27313c; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px #000; transition: background .12s, box-shadow .12s; }
.leds .on .capsule { --led: var(--accent); background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #fff 0 12%, var(--led) 45%); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--led); }
.leds .on:nth-child(n + 9) .capsule { --led: var(--amber); }
.leds .on:nth-child(11) .capsule { --led: var(--coral); }

.skirt { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(#28313c 0 4deg, #1b222b 4deg 8deg); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -12px #000; }
.cap { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #2f3a47, #161c23 75%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #46525f; }
.turn { rotate: var(--turn, -145deg); transition: rotate .15s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
.pointer { height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--text); }
.knob:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.knob:focus-visible .skirt { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent), 0 18px 40px -12px #000; }
.knob .readout strong { font-size: clamp(20px, 7cqmin, 30px); }
```

```js
const leds = document.getElementById('leds');
leds.innerHTML = '<div class="satellite"><div class="capsule"></div></div>'.repeat(11);
const knob = document.querySelector('.knob');
let step = 0;
const set = s => {
  step = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, Math.round(s)));
  // 290° over ten steps, starting at 215° (-145° from the top).
  knob.style.setProperty('--turn', `${-145 + step * 29}deg`);
  [...leds.children].forEach((led, i) => led.classList.toggle('on', i <= step && step > 0));
  knob.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', step);
  document.getElementById('step').textContent = step;
};
const fromPointer = event => {
  const box = knob.getBoundingClientRect();
  const angle = Math.atan2(event.clientX - (box.left + box.width / 2), (box.top + box.height / 2) - event.clientY) * 180 / Math.PI;
  if (Math.abs(angle) <= 160) set((angle + 145) / 29);
};
knob.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { knob.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); fromPointer(event); });
knob.addEventListener('pointermove', event => { if (knob.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) fromPointer(event); });
knob.addEventListener('wheel', event => { event.preventDefault(); set(step - Math.sign(event.deltaY)); }, { passive: false });
knob.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
  const delta = { ArrowUp: 1, ArrowRight: 1, ArrowDown: -1, ArrowLeft: -1 }[event.key];
  if (delta) { event.preventDefault(); set(step + delta); }
  if (event.key === 'Home') set(0);
  if (event.key === 'End') set(10);
});
set(5);
```

Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys. The knob snaps to the nearest step.

## How it's built

- Eleven [satellites](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/satellite.html) on `orbit-11` with `range-290 from-215 fit-range`: the first and last sit on the two ends of the sweep, the rest are spread evenly between them.
- A lit LED is a class on its satellite. `:nth-child(n + 9)` and `:nth-child(11)` turn the top steps amber and coral.
- The knob is a satellite on `orbit-0` with a `.gravity-spot` inside: its cap is a centered satellite of that inner system, and its pointer a [`.vector`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html) on `orbit-9`.
- The pointer's ring turns with `rotate`, 29° per step, the same spacing as the LEDs. A springy easing makes each step snap.

## Related

- [Knob with progress bar](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/knobs/knob-with-progress-bar.html): continuous values
- [Dashed progress bar](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/progress/dashed-circular-progress-bar.html): steps without a knob
- [Orbit Kit knob](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/knob.html)

# Pie menu

A two-level menu: each wedge opens its options on an outer ring that covers only its own slice.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang menu" role="menu" aria-label="Text format">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <!-- Three wedges split the inner ring; their names are the arcs' own text. -->
      <div class="orbit-6 main" style="--o-size-ratio: 4; --o-gap: 3">
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="0" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" data-open="size">Size</o-arc>
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="0" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" data-open="style" class="flip">Style</o-arc>
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="0" role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false" data-open="color">Color</o-arc>
      </div>
      <!-- Each submenu is a ring limited to its wedge's slice with from-N range-120. -->
      <div class="orbit-10 sub" id="size" style="--o-size-ratio: 3; --o-gap: 3; --o-range: 120deg" role="menu" aria-label="Size">
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitem" data-size="-2">Smaller</o-arc>
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitem" data-size="2">Larger</o-arc>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-10 sub" id="style" style="--o-size-ratio: 3; --o-gap: 3; --o-range: 120deg; --o-from: 120deg" role="menu" aria-label="Style">
        <!-- Clockwise runs right to left down here: listed backwards, they read left to right. -->
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="false" data-toggle="underline" class="flip">Underline</o-arc>
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="false" data-toggle="italic" class="flip">Italic</o-arc>
        <o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="false" data-toggle="bold" class="flip">Bold</o-arc>
      </div>
      <div class="orbit-10 sub swatches" id="color" style="--o-size-ratio: 3; --o-gap: 3; --o-range: 120deg; --o-from: 240deg" role="menu" aria-label="Color"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 8">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule sample" id="sample">Aa</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage > .menu { width: min(100%, 100vh - 32px); }

.menu o-arc {
  --o-fill: #1b232d; --o-stroke: #2c3846; --o-color: var(--muted);
  font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif;
  transition: scale .18s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}
/* Orbit places arcs with rotate, so a hover scale adds to it. */
.menu o-arc:is(:hover, :focus-visible) { --o-fill: #253040; --o-color: var(--text); scale: 1.03; outline: none; }
.main o-arc[aria-expanded="true"] { --o-fill: var(--accent); --o-stroke: var(--accent); --o-color: var(--bg); }
.sub o-arc[aria-checked="true"] { --o-color: var(--accent); --o-stroke: var(--accent); }
.swatches o-arc { --o-fill: var(--c); --o-stroke: var(--c); }
.swatches o-arc:is(:hover, :focus-visible) { --o-fill: var(--c); --o-stroke: var(--text); }

/* Closed submenus fade and shrink toward the center. */
.sub { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; scale: .9; transition: opacity .2s, scale .2s, visibility .2s; }
.sub.open { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; scale: 1; }

.sample { font-size: 28px; color: var(--c, var(--text)); transition: font-size .15s; }
```

```js
const colors = [['White', 'var(--text)'], ['Teal', 'var(--accent)'], ['Blue', 'var(--blue)'], ['Violet', 'var(--violet)'], ['Coral', 'var(--coral)'], ['Amber', 'var(--amber)']];
document.getElementById('color').innerHTML = colors.map(([name, c]) =>
  `<o-arc interactive tabindex="-1" role="menuitem" aria-label="${name}" data-color="${c}" style="--c: ${c}"></o-arc>`).join('');

const sample = document.getElementById('sample');
const wedges = [...document.querySelectorAll('.main o-arc')];
let size = 28;
const open = wedge => {
  const name = wedge && wedge.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true' ? wedge.dataset.open : null;
  wedges.forEach(w => w.setAttribute('aria-expanded', w.dataset.open === name));
  document.querySelectorAll('.sub').forEach(sub => {
    sub.classList.toggle('open', sub.id === name);
    sub.querySelectorAll('o-arc').forEach(o => { o.tabIndex = sub.id === name ? 0 : -1; });
  });
};
// One handler for every option, by what its data says.
const choose = option => {
  const { size: step, toggle, color } = option.dataset;
  if (step) size = Math.max(16, Math.min(44, size + Number(step)));
  if (toggle) option.setAttribute('aria-checked', option.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true');
  if (color) sample.style.setProperty('--c', color);
  const on = name => document.querySelector(`[data-toggle="${name}"]`).getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true';
  sample.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
  sample.style.fontWeight = on('bold') ? 800 : 400;
  sample.style.fontStyle = on('italic') ? 'italic' : 'normal';
  sample.style.textDecoration = on('underline') ? 'underline' : 'none';
};
document.querySelectorAll('.menu o-arc').forEach(arc => {
  const act = () => (arc.dataset.open ? open(arc) : choose(arc));
  arc.addEventListener('click', act);
  arc.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') { event.preventDefault(); act(); }
    if (event.key === 'Escape') { open(null); wedges[0].focus(); }
  });
});
open(wedges[1]);
choose(document.querySelector('[data-toggle="bold"]'));
```

Click a wedge, or Tab to it and press Enter. Escape closes the submenu.

## How it's built

- Three [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) without `value` split the inner ring into 120° wedges. Their text is drawn along the arc, and `flip` keeps the bottom one readable.
- Each submenu is a ring on `orbit-10` with `--o-range: 120deg` and the `--o-from` of its wedge. Its options split that slice evenly, so they always sit right outside the wedge that opened them.
- `interactive` lets an arc take the pointer and focus; the rest of the square stays click-through. Hover and focus use `scale`, which adds to the `rotate` Orbit places arcs with.
- Closed submenus are faded and scaled to 90% from the center, so opening one grows it outward.
- Wedges are `menuitem`s with `aria-expanded`, style options are `menuitemcheckbox`es, and only the open submenu is in the Tab order.

# Donut chart

Arcs with a `value` follow each other around the ring, so a donut chart is just your data in order.

```html
<main class="stage chart">
  <div class="bigbang donut" role="img" aria-label="Energy use by room">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <!-- Arcs with value stack in DOM order; shares sit on the same lane. -->
      <div class="orbit-8" id="ring" style="--o-size-ratio: 4; --o-gap: 2"></div>
      <div class="orbit-8" id="shares" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 11">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule readout"><strong id="total">0</strong><span>kWh</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="key">
    <ul class="legend" id="legend"></ul>
    <div class="controls">
      <button aria-pressed="true" data-week="0">This week</button>
      <button aria-pressed="false" data-week="1">Last week</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.chart { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6%; }
.chart > .donut { width: min(56%, 100vh - 40px); flex: none; }

.donut o-arc { --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c); }
.share { font: 600 12px var(--mono); color: var(--bg); }

.key { display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
.legend li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.legend i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c); }
.legend span { font: 13px var(--mono); color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.key .controls { gap: 8px; }
button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); }
```

```js
const rooms = [['Kitchen', 'var(--accent)'], ['Living', 'var(--blue)'], ['Office', 'var(--violet)'], ['Bedroom', 'var(--amber)'], ['Bath', 'var(--coral)']];
const weeks = [[52, 38, 31, 14, 9], [41, 46, 22, 19, 12]]; // kWh per room
const ring = document.getElementById('ring'), shares = document.getElementById('shares'), legend = document.getElementById('legend');
ring.innerHTML = rooms.map(([, c]) => `<o-arc style="--c: ${c}"></o-arc>`).join('');
legend.innerHTML = rooms.map(([name, c]) => `<li style="--c: ${c}"><i></i>${name}<span></span></li>`).join('');

let shown = weeks[0];
const draw = data => {
  const total = data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let before = 0;
  shares.innerHTML = '';
  data.forEach((kwh, i) => {
    const share = kwh / total * 100;
    ring.children[i].setAttribute('value', share);
    // A share label goes to the middle of its arc: everything before it, plus half of it.
    const middle = Math.round((before + share / 2) * 3.6);
    if (share >= 6) shares.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="satellite angle-${middle}"><div class="capsule share">${Math.round(share)}%</div></div>`);
    before += share;
    legend.children[i].querySelector('span').textContent = Math.round(kwh) + ' kWh';
  });
  document.getElementById('total').textContent = Math.round(total);
};
// Switching weeks eases from one dataset to the other.
const show = target => {
  const from = shown, start = performance.now();
  const step = now => {
    const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / 600), ease = 1 - (1 - t) ** 3;
    shown = from.map((v, i) => v + (target[i] - v) * ease);
    draw(shown);
    if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
};
document.querySelectorAll('[data-week]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-week]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b === button));
  show(weeks[button.dataset.week]);
}));
draw(shown);
```

## How it's built

- Each room is an [`<o-arc value>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html). Values are shares of 100 (or of `max`), and each arc starts where the one before it ends.
- One ring on lane 8, four lanes thick, leaves room in the middle for the total. `--o-gap: 2` draws the thin line between segments.
- The shares are [satellites](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/satellite.html) on the same lane, turned with `angle-N` to the middle of their arc: the running total before it plus half its own share, times 3.6.
- Switching weeks only rewrites the `value`s, a little at a time; Orbit restacks the arcs on every frame.

## Related

- [Pie chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/pie-chart.html): the hole closed
- [Sunburst chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/sunburst-chart.html): nested data
- [Donut chart demo](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/demos/02-donut-multilayer.html): a hoverable legend
- [Orbit Kit donut](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/kit/donut.html): a ready-made component

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/pie-chart.html

# Pie chart

A pie is a donut with the hole closed: each slice is an arc that reaches all the way to the center.

```html
<main class="stage chart">
  <div class="bigbang pie">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <!-- inner-orbit puts the outer edge on lane 11; 11 lanes thick reaches the center. -->
      <div class="orbit-11" id="slices" style="--o-size-ratio: 11; --o-gap: 0" role="list" aria-label="How people get to work"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="key">
    <div class="readout"><strong id="share">1,240</strong><span id="name">people asked</span></div>
    <ul class="legend" id="legend"></ul>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.chart { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7%; }
.chart > .pie { width: min(54%, 100vh - 72px); flex: none; }

.pie o-arc {
  --o-stroke: var(--bg); --o-stroke-width: 2; --o-fill: var(--c);
  transition: translate .25s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.4, .5, 1), opacity .2s;
}
/* The slice in focus slides out along its middle; the others step back. */
.pie o-arc.on { translate: var(--dx) var(--dy); }
.pie.focus o-arc:not(.on) { opacity: .45; }
.pie o-arc:focus-visible { outline: none; }

.key { display: grid; gap: 16px; justify-items: start; }
.key .readout { justify-items: start; }
.key .readout strong { font-size: 34px; }
.legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; font-size: 14px; }
.legend li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; margin-left: -8px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: default; }
.legend li.on { background: var(--panel); }
.legend i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c); }
.legend span { font: 13px var(--mono); color: var(--muted); padding-left: 12px; }
```

```js
const data = [['Car', 35, 'var(--blue)'], ['Transit', 25, 'var(--accent)'], ['Bike', 15, 'var(--lime)'], ['Walk', 15, 'var(--amber)'], ['Remote', 10, 'var(--violet)']];
const slices = document.getElementById('slices'), legend = document.getElementById('legend'), pie = document.querySelector('.pie');
let before = 0;
data.forEach(([name, share, c]) => {
  // The direction of the slice's middle, for sliding it out 4% of the chart.
  const middle = (before + share / 2) * 3.6 * Math.PI / 180;
  const dx = (Math.sin(middle) * 4).toFixed(2), dy = (-Math.cos(middle) * 4).toFixed(2);
  slices.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<o-arc class="inner-orbit" value="${share}" interactive tabindex="0" role="listitem" aria-label="${name}, ${share}%" style="--c: ${c}; --dx: ${dx}cqmin; --dy: ${dy}cqmin"></o-arc>`);
  legend.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<li style="--c: ${c}"><i></i>${name}<span>${share}%</span></li>`);
  before += share;
});
const arcs = [...slices.children], rows = [...legend.children];
const focus = i => {
  pie.classList.toggle('focus', i >= 0);
  arcs.forEach((arc, j) => arc.classList.toggle('on', i === j));
  rows.forEach((row, j) => row.classList.toggle('on', i === j));
  document.getElementById('share').textContent = i < 0 ? '1,240' : data[i][1] + '%';
  document.getElementById('name').textContent = i < 0 ? 'people asked' : data[i][0].toLowerCase();
};
[...arcs, ...rows].forEach((el, k) => {
  el.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => focus(k % data.length));
  el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => focus(-1));
});
arcs.forEach((arc, i) => {
  arc.addEventListener('focus', () => focus(i));
  arc.addEventListener('blur', () => focus(-1));
});
```

Hover a slice or a row, or Tab through the slices.

## How it's built

- Five [`<o-arc value>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) that add up to 100, stacked in DOM order on one ring.
- `inner-orbit` puts the outer edge of each arc on `orbit-11`, and `--o-size-ratio: 11` makes it eleven lanes thick: all the way in. Lower it to 6 and you have a donut of the same size.
- A thin `--o-stroke` in the background color separates the slices instead of `--o-gap`, which would leave wedges that narrow to nothing at the center.
- `interactive` lets each slice take the pointer and focus. Orbit places arcs with `rotate`, so a `translate` of yours adds to it: the slice in focus slides out along its middle.

## Related

- [Donut chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/donut-chart.html)
- [Sunburst chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/sunburst-chart.html)
- [Arcs](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html)

---

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/sunburst-chart.html

# Sunburst chart

Nested data, one ring per level: if both rings count out of the same total, each part lines up with its category on its own.

```html
<main class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang sunburst">
    <div class="gravity-spot" style="--o-size-ratio: 3.6; --o-gap: 1.5">
      <div class="orbit-6 level" id="inner" role="list" aria-label="A week, by category"></div>
      <div class="orbit-10 level" id="outer" role="list" aria-label="A week, by activity"></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 8">
        <div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule readout"><strong id="hours">0 h</strong><span id="what">awake, one week</span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>
```

```css
.stage > .sunburst { width: min(100%, 100vh - 32px); }

.level o-arc {
  --o-stroke: none; --o-fill: var(--c); --o-color: var(--bg);
  font: 600 12px system-ui, sans-serif;
  transition: opacity .2s;
}
.level o-arc:focus-visible { outline: none; --o-stroke: var(--text); --o-stroke-width: 2; }
/* A branch in focus: everything else steps back. */
.sunburst[data-focus] o-arc:not(.on) { opacity: .3; }
.sunburst .readout strong { font-size: clamp(22px, 16cqmin, 40px); }
```

```js
// Hours in a week, awake. Categories and their parts.
const data = [
  ['Work', 'var(--blue)', [['Meetings', 12], ['Focus', 22], ['Email', 8]]],
  ['Home', 'var(--amber)', [['Cooking', 8], ['Chores', 9], ['Family', 14]]],
  ['Rest', 'var(--accent)', [['Reading', 7], ['Sport', 6], ['Friends', 10], ['Screens', 16]]],
];
const sum = list => list.reduce((total, [, hours]) => total + hours, 0);
const total = data.reduce((all, [, , parts]) => all + sum(parts), 0);
const inner = document.getElementById('inner'), outer = document.getElementById('outer');
let before = 0;
// Text on the lower half is flipped to read the right way up.
const arc = (name, hours, color, branch) => {
  const share = hours / total * 100, middle = (before + share / 2) * 3.6;
  const flip = middle > 90 && middle < 270 ? 'flip' : '';
  return `<o-arc class="${flip}" value="${share}" interactive tabindex="0" role="listitem" data-branch="${branch}"
    aria-label="${name}, ${hours} hours" data-hours="${hours}" style="--c: ${color}">${name}</o-arc>`;
};
data.forEach(([name, color, parts], b) => {
  const start = before;
  inner.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', arc(name, sum(parts), color, b));
  // The parts: lighter shades of the category, in the same order.
  parts.forEach(([part, hours], i) => {
    outer.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', arc(part, hours, `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} ${85 - i * 12}%, var(--bg))`, b));
    before += hours / total * 100;
  });
  before = start + sum(parts) / total * 100;
});

const chart = document.querySelector('.sunburst'), arcs = [...chart.querySelectorAll('o-arc')];
const focus = target => {
  if (target) chart.dataset.focus = ''; else delete chart.dataset.focus;
  // A category lights its parts; a part lights itself and its category.
  arcs.forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('on', !!target && a.dataset.branch === target.dataset.branch &&
    (target.parentElement === inner || a === target || a.parentElement === inner)));
  document.getElementById('hours').textContent = (target ? target.dataset.hours : total) + ' h';
  document.getElementById('what').textContent = target ? target.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() : 'awake, one week';
};
arcs.forEach(a => {
  a.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => focus(a));
  a.addEventListener('focus', () => focus(a));
  a.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => focus(null));
  a.addEventListener('blur', () => focus(null));
});
focus(null);
```

Hover or Tab through the rings: a category lights up its parts.

## How it's built

- Two rings, two levels: `orbit-6` for categories and `orbit-10` for their parts. `--o-size-ratio: 3.6` on the [`.gravity-spot`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/gravity-spot.html) makes each band 3.6 lanes thick; the rings are four lanes apart, which leaves a thin line between levels.
- Every [`<o-arc>`](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html) gets its share of the whole week as `value`. Arcs with values stack in DOM order, so when the parts are listed in the same order as their categories, each one lands inside its parent with no angles to compute.
- The names are the arcs' own text. `flip` turns the text of arcs on the lower half so it reads the right way up, and `--o-color` sets its color.
- Each part is a shade of its category made with `color-mix()`, so a branch reads as one without a legend.
- `interactive` and `tabindex` make every slice hoverable and focusable; the center tells you what you are on.

## Related

- [Donut chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/donut-chart.html): one level
- [Pie chart](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/charts/pie-chart.html)
- [Arcs](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/arc.html)

Source: https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/examples/watches/minimalist-analog-clock.html

# Minimalist analog clock

A clock is a ring of ticks, a ring of numbers and three hands that share a center. This one tells the real time.

```html
<div class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang clock" role="img" aria-label="Clock">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 24"><div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule face"></div></div></div>
      <!-- 60 ticks and 12 numbers, written by the JS tab. -->
      <div class="orbit-11 ticks"></div>
      <div class="orbit-9 numbers" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.6"></div>
      <!-- Each hand is one vector, pointing up. Its ring turns with rotate. -->
      <div class="orbit-3 hand hour" style="--o-size-ratio: 6.6"><div class="vector"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-5 hand minute" style="--o-size-ratio: 10.6"><div class="vector"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-4 hand second" style="--o-size-ratio: 12"><div class="vector"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: .7"><div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule pin"></div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```css
.face { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #1a222c, #0e1318 72%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #26313d; }
.ticks .vector { background: var(--faint); }
.ticks .vector.major { height: 3px; background: var(--text); }
.numbers .capsule { font-size: 55cqmin; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted); }
.hand { rotate: var(--turn, 0deg); }
.hand .vector { height: clamp(2px, 1.4cqmin, 6px); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--text); }
.second .vector { height: 2px; background: var(--amber); }
.running .second { transition: rotate .25s cubic-bezier(.4, 2, .6, 1); }
.pin { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); }
```

```js
// Write `count` items into a ring, from the top, clockwise.
const fill = (ring, count, item) => {
  document.querySelector(ring).innerHTML = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => item(i)).join('');
};
fill('.ticks', 60, (i) => i % 5
  ? '<div class="vector inner-orbit" style="--o-size-ratio: .5"></div>'
  : '<div class="vector inner-orbit major" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.1"></div>');
fill('.numbers', 12, (i) => `<div class="satellite"><div class="capsule">${i || 12}</div></div>`);

// Seconds since midnight, counted up from the page load, so no hand ever jumps back.
const clock = document.querySelector('.clock');
const start = new Date();
const base = start.getHours() * 3600 + start.getMinutes() * 60 + start.getSeconds();
const turn = (hand, deg) => clock.querySelector(hand).style.setProperty('--turn', `${deg}deg`);
function tick() {
  const s = base + Math.round((Date.now() - start) / 1000);
  turn('.hour', s / 120);
  turn('.minute', s / 10);
  turn('.second', s * 6);
  clock.setAttribute('aria-label', `Clock showing ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}`);
}
tick();
requestAnimationFrame(() => clock.classList.add('running'));
setInterval(tick, 1000);
```

## How it's built

- The face is a satellite in the center with `--o-size-ratio: 24`, as wide as the universe. See [satellites](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/satellite.html).
- Sixty [vectors](https://zumerlab.github.io/orbit/reference/vector.html) on `orbit-11`, spaced 6° apart by Orbit. `inner-orbit` hangs them inward from the ring; every fifth one is longer and brighter.
- The numbers are twelve satellites on `orbit-9`. The first child sits at the top, so the list starts with 12.
- Each hand is a single vector on its own ring. A lone vector points up; the ring turns with `rotate` and takes the hand with it. The lane and `--o-size-ratio` set where the hand starts and how long it is.

## Variations

A quieter dial: no numbers, twelve hour marks and two hands.

```html
<div class="stage">
  <div class="bigbang clock" role="img" aria-label="Clock">
    <div class="gravity-spot">
      <div class="orbit-0" style="--o-size-ratio: 24"><div class="satellite at-center"><div class="capsule face"></div></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-11 ticks" style="--o-size-ratio: 1.6"></div>
      <div class="orbit-3 hand hour" style="--o-size-ratio: 6"><div class="vector"></div></div>
      <div class="orbit-5 hand minute" style="--o-size-ratio: 10"><div class="vector"></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```css
.face { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: #10151b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #26313d; }
.ticks .vector, .hand .vector { height: clamp(3px, 1.6cqmin, 6px); border-radius: 3px; }
.ticks .vector { background: var(--accent); }
.hand { rotate: var(--turn, 0deg); }
.hand .vector { background: var(--text); }
```

```js
document.querySelector('.ticks').innerHTML = '<div class="vector inner-orbit"></div>'.repeat(12);

const clock = document.querySelector('.clock');
function tick() {
  const d = new Date(), s = d.getHours() * 3600 + d.getMinutes() * 60 + d.getSeconds();
  clock.querySelector('.hour').style.setProperty('--turn', `${s / 120}deg`);
  clock.querySelector('.minute').style.setProperty('--turn', `${s / 10}deg`);
  clock.setAttribute('aria-label', `Clock showing ${d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}`);
}
tick();
setInterval(tick, 1000);
```
